_comment: Shape reference for the bug report the patcher consumes. Synthetic content:
the locations and prose below are placeholders, not findings. Replace the whole
`bugs` array with the real report when it lands.
visibility: BLIND -- safe to place in a worktree and a prompt
provenance: Every entry is a confirmed defect. This report contains no false positives: the agent must not spend effort deciding whether an entry is real.

bugs.vulnerability: A request parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL statement, so a caller controls the structure of the query rather than only its values.
bugs.reproduction: Issue a request to this endpoint with a parameter value containing SQL syntax and observe that it alters the executed statement.

bugs.vulnerability: Credentials are stored using a fast, unsalted hash, so an attacker holding the store can recover passwords at scale.
bugs.reproduction: Hash a known password with the same routine and confirm the stored value matches, with no per-record salt.
